copy.heading: When were you born?
copy.supportingReferenceLine: Your date is enough to start.
copy.explanation1: This is all the general reading needs — your Sun sign, your Chinese year and sign-to-sign compatibility all follow from the date alone.
copy.explanation2: Birth time and place are not required now. You can add them later in Profile, and they unlock the parts of a chart that genuinely depend on them.
